title: Burke Four Master Tropes Manual — parallel analytical apparatus to the pentad
primary_source: GM-13 (Appendix D — The Four Master Tropes)
purpose: Standalone manual for Burke's Appendix D as parallel analytical apparatus to the pentad. Each trope is a 'discovery and description of truth' function. The four tropes underwrite distinguishable discourse-regimes that construct the game-user-motive in different ways.
content_filter_compliance: All Burke prose paraphrased; no ≥25-word verbatim.
parallel_apparatus_status: The four tropes are a parallel apparatus to the pentad: every trope-deployment is also a pentad-deployment. The dissertation deploys both as a 5×4 cell matrix (pentad term × trope-operation).

tropes.operational_gloss_le80: Seeing one character (anything thinkable as distinct) in terms of another; bringing out the thisness of a that. To consider A from the point of view of B is to use B as a perspective upon A. Reality is not dissolved by multi-perspectivism — it is established by it. Degrees of being correspond to variety-of-perspectives-supportable.
burke_examples: Human motivation considered in terms of conditioned reflexes / chemicals / class struggles / love of God / neurosis / pilgrimage / power / planetary motion / geography / sun spots (GM-13 p.504)
Lifting / smelling / tasting / tapping / holding-in-different-lights as multi-perspective establishment of an object's reality (GM-13 p.504)
tropes.pentad_interaction: Most-implicates AGENCY (a perspective is the means-of-considering) and SCENE (the chosen perspective re-scenes the act). Cross-cuts all five terms whenever the analyst chooses a frame of motives. Each philosophic school's featured pentad term is itself a metaphor / perspective on motivation.
tropes.dissertation_game_user_deployment: Cross-domain mapping in game-discourse: player-as-consumer (economic metaphor); player-as-laborer (labor metaphor); player-as-co-author (literary metaphor); player-as-inhabitant (architectural metaphor); player-as-athlete (sport metaphor). Each metaphor is a perspective on user-motive that selects different ratios for visibility. Game-studies sub-schools (Aarseth's ergodic / Bogost's procedural / Calleja's incorporation / Sicart's play) feature different metaphor-perspectives on the user.
tropes.discourse_regime: Gamification rhetoric and skeuomorphic ports of work/school/fitness into 'play.'

tropes.operational_gloss_le80: Conveying an incorporeal or intangible state in terms of the corporeal or tangible. 'Heart' for 'emotions'; 'commotion' for emotion. All spiritual-realm vocabulary was metonymic in origin. Reduction is the one-direction (quality-to-quantity) special case: scientific realism's trope. Two senses must be tracked: poet's metonymy as figure/symbolization, and scientific behaviorist's metonymy as substantial reduction.
burke_examples: I. A. Richards's substitution of 'commotion' for 'emotion' in *Principles of Literary Criticism* (GM-13 p.506)
Western materialism's reduction of consciousness to motion (GM-13 p.506)
Otto Neurath's isotypes (*Modern Man in the Making*) as reductive vs. realistic portrait painting (GM-13 p.510)
Statistical surveys in sociology as fabulously-amassed reductive misrepresentations (GM-13 p.510)
Korzybski's 'Structural Differential' (string, plugs, tin) as reductive 'way in' (GM-13 p.511)
Thurman Arnold's psychiatric metaphor of social relations (GM-13 p.511)
tropes.pentad_interaction: Most-implicates AGENCY (reduction is methodological apparatus) and SCENE (lower-order realm into which higher is reduced). Decisively implicates ACT when motive is reduced to behavior (poetic vs. scientific behaviorism). Operates the implicit cross-pentad collapse that produces materialist motive-accounts (Agent → Scene; Purpose → Agency).
tropes.dissertation_game_user_deployment: Player-reduced-to-scoreboard-number: KDA ratio, win rate, MMR, engagement minutes, retention curve, conversion funnel as metonymic reductions of player-motive to quantitative correlates. The dissertation can distinguish (a) telemetry-as-figure (poet's use: numbers as symbolization of a quality whose substance lies elsewhere) from (b) telemetry-as-substantial-reduction (scientific-behaviorist use: motive IS the number). **Load-bearing methodological move** for diagnosing 'gamification' rhetoric: gamification often deploys metonymy-as-real-reduction while claiming the warrants of metonymy-as-figure.
tropes.discourse_regime: Telemetric reduction — player as KDA / MMR / retention-curve / conversion-funnel.

tropes.operational_gloss_le80: Convertibility between two terms in integral relationship: part-for-whole, whole-for-part, container-for-contained, sign-for-signified, material-for-thing-made, cause-for-effect, genus-for-species — and all reversals. The 'noblest synecdoche' is microcosm-macrocosm identity (Leibniz). Two-way (unlike metonymy's one-way). Extended by Burke to before/after, implicit/explicit, temporal/logical sequence, name/narrative, disease/cure, hero/villain.
burke_examples: Leibniz's monadology as grand-scale synecdoche; 'representation' is Leibniz's own word (GM-13 p.508)
Rousseau's *volonté générale* as political-representation synecdoche (GM-13 p.508)
tropes.pentad_interaction: Most-implicates AGENT (part-whole convertibility holds especially between an agent and the class/society/cosmos to which the agent belongs) and PURPOSE (macrocosmic whole that microcosmic part instantiates). Underwrites every representative-anecdote choice: which Act/Scene/Agent/Agency/Purpose stands-for the whole of human motivation? Each philosophic-school featuring is a synecdochic election.
tropes.dissertation_game_user_deployment: **Avatar-stands-for-player** — the canonical game-studies synecdoche. Sub-deployments: party-stands-for-player (RPG); civilization-stands-for-player (4X); username-stands-for-player (multiplayer); screenshot/clip-stands-for-session (streaming culture); leaderboard-rank-stands-for-skill (esports). Each is a synecdoche the dissertation can analyze for representativeness (does the avatar truly represent the player, or does it reductively misrepresent — collapsing into metonymy?). The 'well-formed game session' is internally synecdochic: tutorial contains endgame, endgame sums tutorial.
tropes.discourse_regime: Avatar / leaderboard / clip as representative part-for-whole.

tropes.operational_gloss_le80: Arises when one tries, by the interaction of terms upon one another, to produce a development that uses all the terms. From the standpoint of this total form ('perspective of perspectives'), no participating sub-perspective is precisely right or wrong; all are voices integrally affecting one another. True/classic/humble irony is grounded in consubstantiality with the 'enemy'; romantic/Pharisaic irony is grounded in superiority. Over-all formula: A returns as non-A (peripety).
burke_examples: Socrates / proletariat as primus-inter-pares characters within the dialectic
Peripety as A → non-A: classical tragedy reversal
Flaubert / Newton / Falstaff as consubstantial-with-enemy figures
Distinction: classic-humble irony (consubstantiality with the enemy) vs romantic-Pharisaic irony (superiority over the enemy)
tropes.pentad_interaction: Implicates ALL FIVE pentad terms by structural definition: irony requires that all terms (and agents) participate, none being precisely right or wrong. Operates on the ratios as a whole rather than on any individual term. Implicates PURPOSE most centrally in its peripety-formula (A → non-A) and ACT in its peripety-as-reversal mechanic. The primus-inter-pares character is itself a synecdochic election — irony folds back into synecdoche at the level of representative-character selection.
tropes.dissertation_game_user_deployment: **Meta-gaming dialectic** — the player who optimizes most ruthlessly for the designed objective often produces emergent behavior that subverts the design (speedrunning, glitch-exploitation, RMT, botting, grief-play, role-playing-against-roleplay). Burke's A → non-A peripety maps directly: difficulty curve designed to produce mastery (A) returns as toxic gatekeeping (non-A); social system designed to foster cooperation (A) returns as harassment-vector (non-A); reward economy designed to retain players (A) returns as compulsion-loop critique (non-A). **The dissertation deploys Burke's classic/romantic irony distinction as the NORMATIVE CRITERION**: the developer who treats the toxic player as 'not me' deploys romantic-Pharisaic irony; the developer who recognizes consubstantiality — that the toxic optimizer is the rational extension of the designed incentive — deploys classic-humble irony. Consubstantial irony is the diagnostic of good faith.
tropes.discourse_regime: Meta-gaming, speedrunning, glitch-exploitation, emergent-play, the consubstantiality of designer and exploiter.

metaphor_perspective.Act: Choosing the verb-frame (act seen as conquest is seen-from-conquest-as-perspective)
metaphor_perspective.Scene: Choosing the circumference (scene as marketplace vs battlefield vs classroom)
metaphor_perspective.Agency: Choosing the instrument-as-frame (tool vs obstacle vs ritual)
metaphor_perspective.Purpose: Choosing the end-as-frame (profit vs salvation vs mastery)

metonymy_reduction.Act: Reducing act to behavior (poetic vs scientific behaviorism, GM-13 p.506)
metonymy_reduction.Agent: Reducing agent to body / biology / demographics
metonymy_reduction.Purpose: Reducing purpose to quantifiable goal-state (one-direction quality-to-quantity)

synecdoche_representation.Act: Election of one act as standing-for-all-acts (representative-anecdote)
synecdoche_representation.Agency: An instrument representing the order it instantiates (the cross representing salvation)

irony_dialectic.Act: Peripety: A → non-A; act returns as its reversal
irony_dialectic.Scene: Scene reframed by perspective of perspectives
irony_dialectic.Agent: Consubstantiality with the 'enemy' agent (Flaubert / Newton / Falstaff)
irony_dialectic.Agency: Dialectical interaction of means producing emergent unintended results
irony_dialectic.Purpose: Internal fatality: purpose that arose in time perishes in time

trope_pentad_interaction_matrix.note: Burke does not lay out this matrix explicitly, but every trope-pair operation in the essay is also a pentad-term operation. The matrix is the dissertation's parallel-apparatus 5×4 grid.

mutual_transformability.claim: The four tropes mutually transform into one another at their margins, just as the pentad terms do. A metaphor sustained into systematic correspondence becomes synecdoche (microcosm-macrocosm). A synecdoche enforced one-directionally (part-substituted-for-whole as the only legitimate move) becomes metonymy (reduction). A metonymy whose direction is reversed by exposing its substitution (A=Y is read as 'A returned as non-A') becomes irony.
mutual_transformability.dissertation_use: The diagnostic move: when a game-studies discourse claims metaphor-warrants (figural, multi-perspectival) but operationalizes metonymy-machinery (one-direction reductive), the dissertation can name the rhetorical slippage. Gamification is the standing case: claims metaphor-warrants ('play is like work'), operationalizes metonymy ('engagement is the number of clicks').

parallel_apparatus_to_pentad.status: The four tropes are a parallel analytical apparatus to the pentad. Both are organons of motive-analysis; both cross-cut all five pentad terms; both admit non-bijective featuring (a single trope-deployment can dominate while the others are present).
parallel_apparatus_to_pentad.complementarity: Pentad answers WHAT IS THE FORMAL STRUCTURE of a motive-statement. Tropes answer WHAT KIND OF FIGURAL OPERATION is being performed within that structure. The dissertation deploys both: each user-motive analysis names its featured pentad term + its featured trope-operation.
parallel_apparatus_to_pentad.5x4_matrix_use: The dissertation moves through a 5 pentad × 4 trope grid for each game-discourse analysis. Each cell asks: how does this trope operate when this pentad term is featured?

dissertation_deployment_summary.core_claim: The four-trope apparatus is the dissertation's primary lens for distinguishing how game-discourse constructs the user-motive.

discourse_regime_mapping.metaphor: Cross-domain framing (gamification rhetoric; skeuomorphic ports of work/school/fitness into 'play')
discourse_regime_mapping.metonymy: Telemetric reduction (player as KDA / MMR / retention-curve / conversion-funnel)
discourse_regime_mapping.synecdoche: Avatar / leaderboard / clip as representative part-for-whole
discourse_regime_mapping.irony: Meta-gaming, speedrunning, glitch-exploitation, emergent-play, consubstantiality of designer and exploiter

dissertation_deployment_summary.normative_criterion: Burke's classic-vs-romantic-irony distinction is the load-bearing methodological move for the dissertation's critique of developer/academic discourse about 'toxic' or 'whale' players. A developer who treats the toxic optimizer as 'not me' deploys romantic-Pharisaic irony. A developer who recognizes consubstantiality — that the toxic optimizer is the rational extension of the designed incentive — deploys classic-humble irony. The pipeline equips the dissertation with both a typology (the four tropes) and a normative criterion (consubstantial irony as the diagnostic of good faith).
